# products
- One file per product. Copy products/_template.md. Name: short-product-name.md.
- Stock lives only here. Update "Last counted" every time stock changes.
- Price = cost per piece x 3, rounded to the nearest 5. Wholesale = 60% of retail. If cost is unknown, price is unknown.
- Never write API keys, tokens or passwords in these files.

# Publishing
- Channels: Instagram and the online shop. Tone: warm, plain, no hype. One idea per post.
- Prices and stock come from products/ only. If unknown, ask.
- No customer names or photos without their OK.
- Show every draft for approval before calling it done.

nodes.name: product-listing
nodes.text:
Goal: a listing that is accurate first and warm second.

## Gather (read, do not guess)
1. Read the product file and .claude/rules/publishing.md.
2. Ask only for what is missing: photos taken, anything special about this batch.

## Do
3. Run the orders skill's restock-check for this product first.
4. Draft: one-line hook, 2-3 lines on how it is made, specs as bullets, price and stock from the product file.

## File it
- Save in drafts/YYYY-MM-DD-product-listing.md.
- Show it for approval.

## Never
- Invent specs, prices or stock. Unknown = "unknown".

nodes.name: new-order
nodes.text:
Goal: every order or quote is priced by the rules and tracked to delivery.

## Gather (read, do not guess)
1. Read the product files involved, the customer file (if any) and projects/now.md.
2. Ask only for what is missing: items, quantities, retail or wholesale, deadline.

## Do
3. Price each item from its product file (retail, or wholesale if 12+ pieces). If a cost is unknown, stop and say which.
4. Check stock. If short, say how many must be made and by when.
5. For a quote, draft the reply: items, unit price, total, lead time. No discounts unless I say so.

## File it
- Add the order or quote to the customer file (create it from customers/_template.md if new).
- Sales go to ledger.md only when paid.
- Update "Where I stopped" and "Next step" in projects/now.md.

## Never
- Invent facts, numbers or quotes. Unknown = "unknown".
- Write addresses or emails in any file.

nodes.name: restock-check
nodes.text:
Goal: never list or promise a piece that is not on the shelf.

## Gather (read, do not guess)
1. Read every file in products/ with status "for sale" and projects/now.md.
2. Ask only for what is missing: a fresh count if "Last counted" is older than 7 days.

## Do
3. List each product: in stock, last counted, open orders or quotes that need it.
4. Flag anything at 3 or fewer, or short for an open order.
5. Suggest a making plan: what to throw first, and the clay needed (suppliers/).

## File it
- Update stock and "Last counted" in each product file.
- Update "Next step" in projects/now.md.

## Never
- Invent stock numbers. Unknown = "unknown".

nodes.name: review
nodes.text:
Goal: step back once a month, see what really happened, and set next month's focus.

1. Read projects/now.md, decisions.md, ledger.md and every file changed since the last review in reviews/.
2. Ask only for what you cannot find in the files. Never invent progress or numbers.
3. Write reviews/YYYY-MM.md:
   - Done (with file links)
   - Not done, and why
   - Money: sales, costs, net, from ledger.md only
   - Decisions made
   - What broke, and the pitfall added
   - Next focus: max 3 must-dos, riskiest first
4. If behind: say so plainly and propose cutting scope, not adding hours.
5. Update projects/now.md: focus, must-dos, next step.
6. Show me the review for approval.

nodes.name: session-close
nodes.text:
Goal: nothing from this session is lost. The next session starts with full context.

1. Ask ONE question: "Paste or dictate everything from this session: what you made, sold, broke, decided, spent, and what's next." Accept messy notes.
2. File each piece in the area it belongs to (products/, customers/, suppliers/). Create new files from the area's _template.md; append dated entries to existing ones. If a piece fits no area, ask; do not invent a folder.
3. Update shared files:
   - decisions.md: any choice made, with the reason
   - ledger.md: every cost and sale, with the date
   - projects/now.md: "Where I stopped", "Next step", tick off must-dos, park new ideas
4. If something broke or Claude repeated a mistake, add one line to "Common pitfalls" in CLAUDE.md: what broke -> rule, status [happened].
5. Before filing "X lives in Y" or a status, check Y still exists and matches. Fix or flag stale notes.
6. If I stated a new rule ("always...", "never..."), ask where it goes (CLAUDE.md or a rules file). Keep CLAUDE.md under 150 lines.
7. Never invent. Missing = "unknown", listed for me.
8. End with 5 lines: files changed, open questions, the one next step.

description: Use at the end of any working session ("close session", pasting raw notes of what I did), to ask where I stopped, and for the monthly review. Not for orders or listings.

Entry skill for the working rhythm. Read only the playbook that matches the request, then follow it.

| If I ask to... | Read and follow |

If the request fits neither, stop and say so; do not guess a playbook.

nodes.name: Slow Clay: second brain map
nodes.text:
# Slow Clay: second brain map
<!-- Keep under 150 lines. Rules for one folder go in .claude/rules/, procedures go in .claude/skills/. -->

## What this is
A one-person online shop selling handmade ceramics (mugs, bowls, planters), run on evenings and weekends.
Goal: 30 orders a month and the shop paying for its own materials by June 2027.

## Where things live
- projects/now.md: current focus, where I stopped, next step (always loaded)
- decisions.md: every choice, with the reason
- products/: one file per product: specs, cost per piece, price, stock, photos to take
- customers/: one file per repeat customer or wholesale lead: orders, preferences, follow-ups
- suppliers/: one file per supplier: what I buy, prices, lead times, minimum orders
- drafts/: Instagram posts and product listings in progress
- reviews/: one monthly review (reviews/2027-01.md)
- ledger.md: every cost and sale, real numbers only

## Always true
- Language: English. Tone: warm, plain, no hype.
- Plan before building or spending: outline what, how, files, tools and cost, then wait for my OK.
- Secrets only in environment variables. Never in files, drafts, screenshots or commits.
- Private notes go in CLAUDE.local.md, never in shared files.
- Prices are always cost per piece x 3, rounded to the nearest 5. Never quote a price that is not in products/.
- Customer addresses and emails never go in these files; they stay in the shop platform.

## How to answer
- Look up the file before answering. Name the file you used.
- If no file covers it, say so and suggest which file to create.
- Never invent results, numbers, quotes or causes. Missing data = ask.

## Treat memory as possibly stale
- A note saying "X lives in Y" was true when written, not necessarily now.
- Before acting on one, check the file, folder or tool still exists. Check numbers against their source file.
- If it changed, trust what you see now, tell me, and fix or delete the stale note.

## Common pitfalls
Format: what broke -> the rule that prevents it. [seeded] = known risk, [happened] = it really broke. Add a line every time something breaks or Claude repeats a mistake.
- [happened] Listed a mug as in stock after the last one sold at a market -> restock-check before every listing; stock lives only in products/.
- [seeded] A rule I only typed in chat vanished after compaction -> write every rule that matters in a file.
- [seeded] CLAUDE.md grew too long and was followed less -> keep it under 150 lines; move folder rules to .claude/rules/, procedures to skills.
- [seeded] A "never do X" written here was ignored -> anything critical needs a hook or permission rule, not a sentence.
- [seeded] Two files contradicted each other -> keep one source of truth; ask for a second-brain audit.
- [seeded] A number appeared that I never gave -> missing data is "unknown" or a question.

## Skills
- rhythm: session-close, review
- orders: new-order, restock-check
- content: product-listing
Each group is an entry SKILL.md that routes to its playbooks. Claude Code only discovers top-level skill folders.

## Naming
- lowercase-with-hyphens.md, one topic per file. Copy the folder's _template.md.

## Always in focus
- @projects/now.md

nodes.name: How to use this second brain (for you, not for Claude)
nodes.text:
# How to use this second brain (for you, not for Claude)

## Check it loads
Open Claude Code in this folder and run /context. CLAUDE.md must appear under memory files.

## The loop
- START: "Read projects/now.md and tell me where I stopped."
- DURING: do the work. Keep rough notes anywhere: bullets, voice dictation, photos.
- END (2 min): "Close this session" + paste your raw notes. Claude files everything.
- MONTHLY: "Do the monthly review" on the first Sunday of the month.

## Skills: say it in plain words
| Group | Playbooks | Say something like |
|---|---|---|
| rhythm | session-close, review | "Close this session" + notes / "Do the monthly review" |
| orders | new-order, restock-check | "New order from the cafe: 24 mugs" / "What needs restocking?" |
| content | product-listing | "Write the listing for the planter" |

## Rules of thumb
- If it matters, it goes in a file. Chat instructions vanish after compaction.
- Never put customer addresses, emails or API keys in any file.
- CLAUDE.md stays under 150 lines. Rules for one folder go in .claude/rules/.
- When something breaks, it goes into "Common pitfalls" in CLAUDE.md. Session close does this for you.
